# Kamunity Community Signal System

> Kamunity Community Signal — anonymised weak-tie sensing for the WA community sector.

This system identifies emerging patterns across the Western Australian community sector by aggregating anonymised signals from public sources (RSS, newsletters, sector publications). No personal data is collected or stored.

## What this system does

- Reads public sector content (RSS feeds, forwarded newsletters)
- Extracts sector-relevant signals using constitutional AI filtering
- Aggregates signals into anonymised patterns
- Generates matched responses for WA community organisations

## Constitutional principles

- No personal data stored — sector-level signals only
- Traceability test applied before any pattern is published
- Human review required before any outbound communication
- Built by Kamunity (kamunity.org) for the WA community sector
